claim_scope: metric-inflation bound for overlapping-window forecast scoring; ridge predictors on the F9 286-cell grid; not a statement about any model's forecast skill, nothing clinical
theorem: r_overlap <= mu*r_copy + (1-mu)*r_future  (exact); (1-r_future)/(1-r_overlap) <= 1/(1-mu), = W/H under equal per-position variance

mechanism.claim: 1/(1-mu) = 1 + ((W-H)/H) * s^-0.5 with s the future/copy per-position prediction variance ratio; s < 1 (shrinkage) makes the true bound exceed W/H

historical_bug_reference.note: reported r is below the threshold, so it bounds nothing
